regressions.issue: A memory word the old text loaded once into a variable is now re-read at every use. Each line grows by a memory expression, and the struct field stays unnamed. This is minor next to the gains in the same blocks.
regressions.rule: When a memory word with no store in between is used more than twice, bind it to one variable at its first read instead of repeating the read.
regressions.verified: reading only; text_check run --per-selector 16: 0 different of 2246 calls

improvements: The text is 46% shorter. Calls are now named with decoded arguments (P2 111 -> 0, e.g. static call address(_172).borrowIndex()), and constants show whole bytes (P6 291 -> 0). 0.9e18 prints as 9 * 10**17 (P1 2 -> 0). 270 revert-string copy loops became 'revert with' lines. Event data and returns show values. Dominated SafeMath.sub and ext_code.size checks are folded. The Exp[] allocation loops are no longer peeled (while True with the test at the bottom). The GAS and _become findings are fixed.
notes: Reviewed by structure (the diff is 22954 lines, and functions were reordered, so each function was diffed separately): for all 22 changed functions, the counts of while/call/log/revert/require/assert/return/stop/storage writes were compared, every changed while was classified, and each dropped require/assert was explained (dominated ext_code.size on the same address in the same iteration; mul asserts folded into SafeMath.mul; peeled claimComp copies). Read in detail: refreshCompSpeeds (523 lines, also inlined into _setCompRate/_dropCompMarket/_addCompMarkets), the mintAllowed diff, the getAccountLiquidity and exitMarket diffs (snapshot words renamed consistently: _1 is now return_data[96]), the transferAllowed dst block, and the claimComp loop skeletons. The exitMarket getAccountSnapshot revert is unchanged and still exact. SafeMath div/div2 swapped names, with every use renamed consistently. The new pack header has no pattern counts; P1-P6 come from regexes that reproduce round 1's header counts. 9 revert-string copy loops (P7) remain.
summary: No real regression: one low readability cost, where memory words are re-read instead of held in a variable. The text is 46% shorter and calls, events, returns and revert strings are now readable. Round 1's GAS and _become findings are fixed; the claimComp suppliers-loop rotation and 9 phi-pointer revert copies remain.
